meta.title: Before: 1 machine file per trigger (flat)
meta.explanation: Smoke test with the job's default `--files-per-trigger 1`. Each micro-batch held one machine, i.e. a single key of the `applyInPandasWithState` operator, so one task did all the scoring while the other cores sat idle; the second core only added scheduling overhead. The runs below therefore put 8 machines in each micro-batch.
